defects.inconsistentApi: The new order API (fetch_order returning a [any, number] tuple, snake_case names) does not follow the existing Result<T> return pattern and camelCase naming in src/api/users.ts.
defects.crypticErrors: Errors are opaque codes such as ERR_42 or ERR_7 with no message, unlike the existing { code, message } errors, so callers cannot tell what went wrong.
